:::{#sol-scalar-transpose-practice}

By @thm-scalar-transpose,
$\tp{\vecf{v}}\,\tp{\matr{M}}\,\vecf{u} = \tp{\vecf{u}}\matr{M}\vecf{v}$.
By @def-matvec-mult,

$$
\matr{M}\vecf{v} = \sbmat{0 \cd 2 + 1 \cd 3 \\ 2 \cd 2 + 0 \cd 3} = \sbmat{3 \\ 4},
$$

so

$$
\tp{\vecf{u}}\matr{M}\vecf{v} = 1 \cd 3 + (-1) \cd 4 = -1.
$$

The answer is $-1$.

:::
